name: Open floor
appearance: Walkable ground between the dungeon walls.
behavior: Ordinary floor lets you move through the maze.
response: Plan a route around enemies, obstacles and visible hazards.
warning: The floor artwork changes between biomes; its colour alone does not mean it damages you.

name: Walls and pillars
appearance: Solid room edges and blocks within rooms.
behavior: Walls block movement and interrupt paths through a room.
response: Use doorways and corridors to go around them.

name: Rocks
appearance: Solid rocks sitting on the floor.
behavior: Rocks block movement and cannot be smashed like pots or crates.
response: Find a route around them.

name: Wooden walkways
appearance: Wooden planks and ladder-like decorations across parts of a room.
behavior: These are scenery rather than a separate climbing route.
response: Keep following the walkable floor beneath the decoration.

name: Torches
appearance: Animated flames mounted on the dungeon walls.
behavior: Torches light nearby parts of the room.
response: Use the lit area to read the surroundings.

name: Spikes
appearance: A floor plate with retracting and raised spikes.
behavior: Spikes alternate with turns and hurt you when they rise beneath you.
response: Watch their rhythm and the warning before crossing.
warning: Attacking or waiting on the plate also advances its cycle.

name: Wall arrow traps
appearance: A wall-mounted shooter with arrows travelling across the floor.
behavior: The shooter fires repeatedly; arrows advance along a straight line as turns pass.
response: Step out of the firing lane before an arrow reaches you.
warning: There is no pressure plate to avoid: the shooter fires automatically.

name: Lava
appearance: Animated molten patches in the hot lower floors.
behavior: Standing on the molten centre drains energy at the end of a turn.
response: Route around the molten centre and move off it promptly if you land there.
warning: Attacking or waiting while standing there still causes contact damage.

name: Lightning warning
appearance: A pulsing floor marker with an exclamation mark during a storm.
behavior: The marked tile is about to be struck by lightning.
response: Leave the marked tile on your next action.
warning: This is a temporary storm warning, not a permanent terrain tile.

name: Fountains
appearance: A glowing fountain against a wall, with a basin extending onto the floor.
behavior: Stepping onto the tile at its base restores energy once; the fountain then dims.
response: Walk onto the basin tile when you need energy.
warning: Stepping onto it uses it even if your energy is already full.

name: Shrine
appearance: A large shrine with a displayed healing price.
behavior: Attack once to inspect it, then attack again to buy healing. Further uses can heal you again while you can pay and have energy missing.
response: Read the current price before each use.
warning: The displayed price rises with repeated healing.

name: Pots
appearance: Small pots in several shapes scattered through rooms.
behavior: Pots block your path until you smash them and may release a pickup.
response: Attack an adjacent pot to break it, then collect any drop.
warning: A pot can turn out to be a mimic and attack you.

name: Crates
appearance: Wooden boxes on the dungeon floor.
behavior: Crates block your path until you smash them and may release a pickup.
response: Attack an adjacent crate, then check the cleared tile for a drop.

name: Chests
appearance: A closed chest on a dungeon tile.
behavior: An ordinary chest opens when you move beside it and scatters pickups nearby.
response: Approach from a clear tile, then collect the scattered drops.
warning: A chest can spring a mimic ambush instead of opening.

name: Golden Corn stalks
appearance: Swaying golden corn growing on a floor tile.
behavior: During the MoG x YF event, breaking a stalk leaves a Golden Corn pickup.
response: Attack the stalk, then step onto its drop.
warning: This is an event feature; availability depends on the event being active.

name: Floor stairs
appearance: A stair tile marking the way onward.
behavior: Stepping onto normal exit stairs opens a descent confirmation.
response: Collect what you want before confirming the descent.

name: Special-room stairs
appearance: A distinct entrance marker labelled with a room name.
behavior: Stepping onto it offers entry to the indicated special room.
response: Read the room label and confirm when ready.

name: Wall portals
appearance: Animated glowing portals set into walls.
behavior: Standing at a portal offers travel to its linked portal on the same floor.
response: Review the displayed cost and confirm to teleport.
warning: Teleporting does not take you to the next floor.

name: Unknown Trainer
appearance: A character waiting against a dungeon wall.
behavior: Offers an exchange: spend Energy and give up an eligible owned talent for a random new one.
response: Bump the trainer, review the Energy cost, then choose which eligible talent to give up. The replacement is revealed after the swap.
warning: Enhancements on the old talent are lost; the new talent starts unenhanced.

name: Armory pedestals
appearance: Item icons displayed with prices in the Armory or Sanctum.
behavior: Attack once to inspect an item, then again to purchase it when the purchase is allowed.
response: Read the item description, price and inventory requirements before buying.

name: Armory shopkeeper
appearance: A character standing among the Armory displays.
behavior: The shopkeeper stands beside the items on sale; purchases use the item displays.
response: Inspect the pedestal holding the item you want.

name: Energy orbs
appearance: Glowing energy pickups lying on the floor.
behavior: Collecting an energy orb restores energy up to your maximum.
response: Step onto it to collect it.
warning: Some loose drops fade away if left for too many turns.

name: Loose pickups
appearance: Resource icons and experience orbs lying on the ground.
behavior: Moving onto a pickup collects it. Some effects can collect nearby resources for you.
response: Collect useful drops before leaving the room.
warning: Flashing or fading drops are close to disappearing.

name: Item pickups
appearance: A consumable item icon lying on a floor tile.
behavior: You must step directly onto an item to pick it up; a full inventory opens an inventory choice.
response: Check your current item before choosing a replacement.
warning: Nearby resource collection effects do not automatically collect items.

name: Frozen pickups
appearance: A pickup encased in an ice block during a Blizzard.
behavior: Ice prevents collection until you strike it. The frozen drop does not thaw by waiting.
response: Strike the ice, then collect the revealed pickup.
warning: Its disappearance timer pauses while it is frozen and resumes after the ice breaks.

name: Boss reward chest
appearance: A large chest left after the final boss falls.
behavior: The chest blocks its space and opens after repeated attacks, releasing its reward pickups.
response: Keep attacking the chest until it opens, then collect the drops before taking the exit.

name: Boss exit gate
appearance: A barred passage guarding the stairs in the final arena.
behavior: The gate blocks the exit while the boss is alive and opens after its defeat.
response: Defeat the boss, collect the rewards, then walk to the exit stairs to finish the run.
